title: Two Weeks In: A 15-Year QA Veteran, Back to Being the New Guy
why_read: A personal, informal reflection on starting a new QA job, offering little transferable technical insight for most readers.
analysis: This is a first-person blog post from an experienced QA professional describing their first two weeks at a new AI agent startup, focusing on differences in team process and pace compared to their previous job. It's a personal narrative rather than a technical deep dive, though it touches lightly on how AI startups structure their development pipelines. Readers looking for concrete technical lessons about testing AI agents will find little substance here based on the excerpt.
